items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My first impression of Charles Mingus, as I recall it, was the impression that remained with me throughout my friendship and exposure to Charles Mingus

ctx.x: Was this also the time when you first met Charles Mingus, or does that come at a later time?

More than likely it was during that cycle that I first met Charles Mingus. I don’t remember the circumstances or the incident in which I met Charles Mingus, but I did meet him at some point. I never worked a lot with Charles Mingus. I don’t know that
I ever recorded with Mingus. Did I?
